primary_path: Disorders of the liver and biliary system, noninfectious
blueprint.competency: Medical Knowledge: Applying Foundational Science Concepts
blueprint.competency_task: Identifies the membrane-transport mechanism producing a bilirubin phenotype.

difficulty.rationale: Requires integration of discriminating clinical clues with a mechanism or diagnosis rather than isolated fact recall.

option_audit.correct: Matches the exact OATP1B1/OATP1B3 sinusoidal uptake/reuptake defect.
option_audit.MRP2: Plausible benign conjugated hyperbilirubinemia but represents Dubin-Johnson canalicular export failure.
option_audit.UGT1A1: Produces impaired conjugation and therefore unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia.
option_audit.BSEP: Produces cholestasis through bile-acid export failure rather than isolated Rotor syndrome.
option_audit.ATP7B: Produces Wilson disease and abnormal copper handling, not this isolated bilirubin-transport phenotype.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Isolated predominantly conjugated hyperbilirubinemia since childhood, normal liver enzymes, no hemolysis, absence of dark pigment and loss of OATP1B1/OATP1B3 identify Rotor syndrome; the mechanism is impaired sinusoidal hepatic uptake/reuptake of conjugated bilirubin.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: MRP2 loss causes Dubin-Johnson syndrome and is the closest alternative because it also causes benign conjugated hyperbilirubinemia, but it is a canalicular export defect and classically produces dark hepatic pigment; the stem instead supplies OATP1B1/OATP1B3 loss and no pigment.
adversarial_second_pass.other_distractors: UGT1A1 causes unconjugated hyperbilirubinemia; BSEP causes cholestatic bile-acid disease; ATP7B causes copper accumulation and Wilson disease.
adversarial_second_pass.cueing_check: Naming OATP1B1/OATP1B3 makes the task mechanistic. The correct option states the direction and membrane-side consequence rather than repeating the transporter names.
adversarial_second_pass.unsupported_precision_check: No bilirubin cutoff or genotype frequency is required for the answer.
